method: Read all baseline Step9 text and actual candidate Step9 through immediately before Step9b, compare commands/flags and each authority, condition, budget, failure, persistence and terminal branch; compare inline literal set as supplemental check. No runtime or model execution.

checks.finding: Mandatory pre-PR in both modes; test/manual-review excuses forbidden; slot resolution, exact diff/spec/tests/AC inputs; autonomous invocation context/fail-safe false and lights_out once-resolved context remain orthogonal prose inputs. Ledger owns mandatory outage flag; prior findings directory/system append and nonzero handling retained.

CLI resolver and unattended all-off short circuit, posture OR one-build flags, four-lens spec review, advisory code-review outage and holdout OFFER/RUN/decideFloor timing remain. No autonomous authority, ledger mint/escalation, appetite or eligibility change.

Bash diff capture block byte-identical; fetched origin default/no local main fallback, git-only local default, fresh file and same-byte hash retained. Heartbeat exact issue-scoped explicit run command, entry/between/after review and before/after holdout timing, no latest run, soft no-op and single-call age bound retained.

Exact read command, exit3/missing Phase1 fresh, matching hash Phase1 skip and complete/pending/in_flight routes, changed hash invalidation, git/PR/worktree truth, slot run/issue/base forwarding and exact phase-write flags retained. Interactive bypass retained.

Block JSON parse/CLI sole authority; native-prose fallback only absent block; malformed/unknown needs-human; Phase2 CLI disposition cannot be hand-adjusted. Four signals and canonical revert test remain.

Autonomous critical/default-on gate, interactive zero rounds, private directory; round schema and CLI-derived identity/carry metadata; malformed author-clear fail-safe; churn then convergence then rebuttal cap(default1); appetite-scaled fix cap and max-char secret-scrubbed untrusted rebuttal; independent withdrawal/judge overturn authority; turn hold and would-be-park stop remain.

Exact assemble/admit/judge-admitted commands and flags; latest captured diff, blinded scrubbed per-finding/null-defence/coin-swapped evidence,0600, two phases, retry_limit and canonical verdict block retained. Admission requires all findings; unresolved park. Foreground timeout600000/call budget540, first exit3 reinvokes then strictly falling attempts with heartbeat/same args, otherwise admit remain.

Interactive unavailable writer/park; autonomous checkpoint/retry default0 and bound3; terminal park writer/label/reason/store cleanup; retry hold does not write floor, increments counter, stashes carried rounds, exit4 retry once/nonzero park, single-select labels clears breadcrumb, lease release/status backward move, exact notice/return/bucket/annotation/no PR retained. Work critical never receives outage hold.

Resumed shipped/fail/needs-human cleanup, extra parked label, repeated carried outage count; every claimed build terminal breadcrumb and lease release, all three named no-op logs/non-halting and tidy/reclaim backstops retained.

Actual read command exits0/3/2/4 and resumed-store safeguard; hold default0/bound2; terminal park/store cleanup; no-floor nonterminal stash with counter increment and carried round counters/one exit4 retry; role-key label transition, no parked, breadcrumb clear, release/status/notice/exact return/bucket/annotation remain.

Tracker issue only; every-pass hard-floor log and all Phase1/Phase2 dispositions/source/severity/model, no invented rationale, unavailable excluded from round records; exact writer/prior-dir and exit1/2 causes remain. Terminal sole writer/all-round history/fixed only on pass, judge/park routes, no handwriting/manual-recovery-only flag, missing artifact fail-closed/audit anchor retained. One terminal comment and gateway identity/live read/planner/result handling remain.

Pass to9b then merge confidence; interactive same-turn no confirmation and exact fallback offer; fail pre-PR loop, needs-human no-PR handoff distinct from already-open PR causes, unavailable resumable bound/no floor return; separable follow-ups discovered scope rather than fail-loop retained.

inherited_conflicts.issue: needs-human signal table says flip PR to draft while entry/terminal branches require pre-PR and no PR opened.
inherited_conflicts.assessment: Present in baseline and candidate; deliberately preserved, not newly resolved or introduced.

inline_literals_not_preserved_as_separat.assessment: Formatting/explanatory spans only: config no-hand-read instruction becomes CLI-only resolver; Todo/true/false/autonomous:true/sha/checkpoint retain prose or containing command meanings; standalone logs/diff snippets retain actual paths and identical executable diff block. No lost executable command/flag found.

limits: Source-only comparison, not model fidelity or workflow qualification.
No tests, source, allowance, frozen record or commit edits; only this review record written.
